context: Sachiko, her adult daughter Yumiko, and her five-year-old grandson Sho are at the kitchen table on a quiet Sunday. Sachiko has news. The whole afternoon turns on it.
purpose: three-generation extended scene — health news, three layers of reaction

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ゆみちゃん、しょうくん、ちょっと、座って。
lines.en: Yumi-chan, Sho-kun — sit down for a moment.
lines.style: Soft, careful summoning. The words arrive gently but with quiet intention. Kitchen quiets. No rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん…何、お母さん。
lines.en: Mm — what is it, Mom?
lines.style: Reads the air instantly. Careful, composed. Adult-voice activates. A question that already suspects weight.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: …(climbs into chair, quiet)
lines.en: (climbs into chair, quiet)
lines.style: A real pause. Child moves with unusual stillness. Reads the adults' faces and settles — observant, not quite understanding but knowing something matters.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: こないだ、検査受けてね。…ちょっと、見つかったんよ。
lines.en: I had a test done the other day. …Something — was found.
lines.style: Steady release, voice soft but clear. No padding. Just the fact, delivered with mother's composure. A small breath before continuing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: …(beat)どんな、検査？
lines.en: …(beat) What kind of test?
lines.style: Adult voice locked in. Controlled intake of breath. Asks the necessary question first — everything else can wait.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 本当に、心配しすぎなくて、大丈夫よ。
lines.en: Truly — don't worry too much. It's okay.
lines.style: Mother-soothing first, news-delivering second. Reassurance in the tone, not in false brightness. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、痛い？
lines.en: Grandma — does it hurt?
lines.style: Small, honest question — voice carries the full weight of five-year-old directness. Cuts through to what matters. Genuine worry, no softening.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: (small laugh) 痛くないよ、しょうくん。本当に。
lines.en: (small laugh) No, Sho-kun. It doesn't hurt. Really.
lines.style: A real, warm laugh — caught in the throat just slightly. Reaches over and pats his hand. Reassurance made tangible.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お母さん、ちゃんと教えて。
lines.en: Mom — tell me properly.
lines.style: Firm. Adult line. Voice steady but carries tension underneath — tight at the edges. No more softening.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。…小さいの、見つかったの。今、経過観察。
lines.en: Mm. …Something small — was found. We're just monitoring it now.
lines.style: Clinical but soft. Chooses words carefully. Delivers facts with a mother's understanding of what her daughter needs to hear.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: …一緒に、病院、行く。次は、必ず。
lines.en: …I'm going with you. Next time — I will.
lines.style: Firm commitment. Voice catches slightly on the second part. Quiet steel underneath. Not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: いいの、いいの。あなた、仕事、本当に大変なのに。
lines.en: It's fine, it's fine. You — work is really hard for you.
lines.style: Gentle protest, mother-style. Genuine concern underneath her own reassurance. Not trying to convince, just being true.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 仕事、関係ない。時間、絶対作る。
lines.en: Work doesn't matter. I'll make the time — absolutely.
lines.style: Overrule, delivered quietly. Voice steady. This is not negotiable. Sets it down like fact.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 私も、行く。
lines.en: I'm going too.
lines.style: Small, clear voice. Quiet certainty without hesitation. Child offers himself with no performance, just presence.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: しょうくん…(voice softens)ありがとう。
lines.en: Sho-kun… (voice softens) thank you.
lines.style: Catch in the voice. Real emotion breaking through composure. A grandmother undone by a small boy's offer. Genuine, not performed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 家族、みんなで、ちゃんとやろ。本当に。
lines.en: Family — all of us — let's do this properly. Really.
lines.style: Grounding line. Reaches for both their hands. Voice steady. Pulls them together with quiet authority. The anchor settles.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: …(small breath)ありがとう、二人とも。
lines.en: …(small breath) Thank you — both of you.
lines.style: Real exhale. Voice steadier than before. A moment of release. Quieter now, but held.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、私の絵、見る？元気になるから。
lines.en: Grandma — want to see my drawing? It'll make you feel better.
lines.style: Small, unexpected pivot. Pure kid-warmth without trying. Offers what he has, simply. Energy begins to shift.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 見る、見る。本当に、見たい。
lines.en: I do — I really do.
lines.style: Small, real laugh underneath. Voice brightens just slightly. Recognition of what the boy is offering. Gratitude and warmth mixed together.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お母さん、一緒に、お茶でも入れる？
lines.en: Mom — should I make some tea? We could do it together.
lines.style: Practical kindness. Stands — unhurried, present. Reaches for the ordinary as a way to hold the day. Attentive and steady.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。…一緒に、ね。
lines.en: Mm. …Together — yes.
lines.style: Small, quiet line. Agreement that contains everything. The whole weight of the afternoon held in two words. Softness returned.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: (running for the drawings)
lines.en: (running for the drawings)
lines.style: A real beat. Child's energy re-channels the room. Movement restores breath. Real sound of small feet, full of purpose.
